summary: Entera Bio Ltd. filed an 8-K reporting a private placement of 134,803,910 ordinary shares and pre-funded warrants at $2.04 per share for aggregate proceeds of approximately $275.0 million to institutional investors including BVF Partners. The transaction closed on July 28, 2026, with 122,961,215 shares and 11,842,695 pre-funded warrants issued. Proceeds will fund the phase 3 study of EB613 and working capital. Leerink Partners acted as lead placement agent with several co-agents. The pre-funded warrants have a nominal exercise price and beneficial ownership limitations, allowing substantial capital infusion without immediate dilution beyond the issuance.
